Marketing Manager — Globex Inc

Globex is hiring a Marketing Manager to lead our brand campaigns.

What you'll need:
- 3+ years of experience in B2B marketing
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Experience managing a small team

This is a remote position open to candidates anywhere in the US.
Salary range: $95,000 - $120,000.

We'd love it if you also had experience with HubSpot or Marketo.
